name: Annan Building - bounded west facade and measured roof

geometry.source_base_note: Substructure datum preserves low source faces; local visible program floors are authored at H57, H60.3 and north H59.

material_review.base_roof_family_note: Stone brick seeds cap states only; all actual main-roof cells retint to polished andesite and low annex fields to smooth stone.

source_controls.scope: Annan Building exterior massing and the photographically supported west face, with conservative south, north and east limitations

identity.match_note: The official map, 2021 facilities plan and county outline identify the stepped building between Tuck Arena and Davy, immediately north of the main gym aggregate.

baseline.detail_status: measured envelope only; no accepted native facade review
baseline.builder_rule: Create a fresh immutable individual study. Do not edit this baseline, completed building studies, shared geometry modules, current campus worlds or the current manifest.

coordinate_frame.horizontal: Physical campus metres X east and Z south. Local U is rotated 9 degrees from east; local V points approximately south.
coordinate_frame.minecraft_transform: Xblock=2*Xmetres; Zblock=2*Zmetres; Yblock=2*(NAVD88metres-25). Keep physical values authoritative and quantize once in the builder.

supports: south gable and low annex relationship
main gable and low east/south annex
trees and neighboring roofs that limit facade visibility
at least four lower west opening patches
sources.limit: Earlier non-generative working enlargement of the official aerial; its original crop/scale record was not retained. Use the frozen official original and context crop for registration, and this enlargement only for visual reading.

supports: four high rectangular windows on one long wrestling-room wall
sources.limit: The school page does not name Annan in this facility section. Assigning the photographed long wall to Annan's west upper exterior is consistent with the exterior four-window row and athletics identity, but remains an inference.

supports: Bissell Wrestling Room above the fitness room
school historical account separately names construction of the Bissell Wrestling Room and Annan Strength Center during David Mercer's tenure
sources.limit: Historical identity/use only; it does not provide an elevation, material schedule or exact room-to-footprint plan.
The 258-272 second approach keeps Annan behind or beyond the larger athletics roofs and never resolves a new Annan facade count.

sources.coverage: 45 consecutive lossless 1920x1080 frames at 0.5-second intervals from 258.0 through 280.0 seconds; frames through 272.0 are unobscured, after which the end logo covers central campus.
sources.annan_finding: No frame supplies a closer or less-occluded Annan elevation than the official still aerial. This negative result prevents unsupported door/window extrapolation.

sources.finding: The crop resolves Mercer/Sweeney/Tuck context; Annan remains concealed or beyond the right/east edge. It must not be used for Annan opening counts.

roof_analysis.rule: The file retains every source polygon and height plane. Grouped controls below route the builder; they do not replace the exact 21 source faces.

low_east_annex.rule: Keep this as a low flat-roof wing. Do not continue the tall main gable over it.

north_entry_recess.rule: Treat the notch and low measured faces as attached/recessed Annan geometry, not a detached shed. Entry and door arrangement remain unresolved.

measured_massing.height_rule: The 55.6699 m source minimum is low local ground/roof-edge data, not a common floor. Keep the lower program near H=57.0, upper program near H=60.3 and north street/entry ground near H=59.0. The H=76.3459 maximum belongs only to the localized north-east high-face cluster.

source_face_controls.role: north recess/entry-side low and pitched faces; preserve as attached geometry
south-edge low transition/canopy/gable fragments; preserve exact faces, do not generalize them into a continuous extra wing

source_face_controls.rule: Preserve these exact source faces and their limited footprint in the first study. Do not use H=76.3459 as a whole-building height, extrude the cluster into another storey, enlarge it, or name it a chimney/tower/copper roof. The official aerial has only a few ambiguous pixels at this location; native review must judge the measured localized form.

west_rink_side.wall: One straight two-level red-brown masonry plane with a restrained pale horizontal division near H=60.6.

upper_windows.count_status: Four small upper openings are directly visible in the official aerial enlargement. The interior photograph independently shows four windows on a long wrestling-room wall; assigning that interior wall to this exterior is inferred.
upper_windows.rule: Use dark narrow panes with occupied masonry heads and sills. Keep the row high below the eave; do not enlarge it into a curtain wall.

lower_windows.count_status: At least four lower dark patches/frames are visible; five positions are a length-scaled interpretation because Tuck/roof occlusion hides parts of the row.
lower_windows.rule: Five is an inferred bounded authoring schedule, not a photographed exact total. Adjust end positions before adding a sixth; do not mirror the upper row mechanically.

south_gable.observed: The red-brown gable is partly visible beyond a foreground roof. A shallow low canopy/entry form occupies the west half and the low annex joins the east half.

bounded_entry_interpretation.rule: One conservative dark entry beneath a thin connected canopy. Do not add a symmetric pair or repeated window grid.

north_street_gable.rule: Preserve the measured attached recess and closed straight gable mass. Door, window and stair arrangement are unseen; do not invent a monumental entry or repeated openings.

east_and_annex.rule: Keep the main east gable distinct from the low annex. Openings are unresolved; use closed ordinary masonry planes except for any source-backed end return needed for enclosure.

tuck_gap.rule: Preserve the open walking/service corridor. Do not bridge or merge Tuck and Annan.

sweeney_gap.rule: Preserve the tight passage and actual grade; do not widen it into an invented lawn or close it with Annan's annex.

davy_gap.rule: Keep the east service/landscape gap open. Do not extend the low annex toward Davy.

site_controls.grade_rule: Use the measured terrain and expose foundations where grade drops. Do not flatten the building to the H=55.6699 source minimum or lift the south/west lower floor to the north H=59 terrain.

palette_guidance.actual: red-brown brick-like masonry; exact unit/product undocumented
palette_guidance.evidence_status: photographically explicit appearance, material species inferred
palette_guidance.rule: Use ordinary coursed masonry texture on straight connected planes. Do not replace the whole facade with smooth terracotta or noisy alternating stripes.

palette_guidance.role: main pitched roof and localized high-face cluster
palette_guidance.actual: medium gray roof; small-unit versus sheet product unresolved
palette_guidance.rule: Use one coherent medium-gray family while preserving every measured cap shape/state. Prefer the less masonry-striped polished-andesite family if native textures remain continuous; do not claim slate, metal or copper.
Keep flat, low and visually subordinate to the main gable.
Use panes in the wall plane with cardinal backing/joins, occupied heads and sills. Select gray or black after native comparison; avoid bright clear panes.

palette_guidance.role: pale west band, canopy and sparse trim
palette_guidance.actual: pale trim/coping appearance; exact stone or concrete unresolved
palette_guidance.rule: Keep trim thin and continuous. Do not create full-block white belts or thick decorative frames unsupported by the aerial.

construction_rules: Preserve the exact 21 source roof faces, campus placement, main ridge/eaves, low annex and localized high-face cluster.
Keep all photographed wall runs on straight analytic planes represented by the minimum connected half-metre raster; no decorative pilaster combs or roof-boundary teeth.
Build the west four-window upper row as observed. Label the five-window lower row interpreted and keep its stated tolerance.
Do not copy the west openings to the north, east or annex walls.
Keep main bar, north recess and low annex physically connected, but do not turn the roof notch into a detached pavilion.
Use the local floors/grades rather than the source minimum as a common datum.
Back roof stairs/slabs, connect panes cardinally, give every pane an occupied head/sill and keep canopies physically attached.
Preserve the Tuck, Sweeney and Davy gaps and current terrain.
